# opnsense_proxy_pac_proxy (Resource)

Proxies offered to clients by the proxy auto-config file (**Services ▸ Squid Web Proxy ▸ Proxy Auto Config ▸ Proxies**).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_proxy_pac_proxy" "corp" {
  name = "corp"
  url  = "proxy.example.com:3128"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the proxy.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `proxy_type` (String) Proxy type written to the PAC file. Defaults to `PROXY`.
- `url` (String) Proxy as `host:port`. Not used with `DIRECT`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the PAC proxy.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_proxy_pac_proxy using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_proxy_pac_proxy.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_proxy_pac_proxy using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_proxy_pac_proxy.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
